aliases: Bitci Kripto Varlık Alım Satım Platformu A.Ş.
Safebit Kripto Varlık Alım Satım Platformu A.Ş.
entity.summary: Turkish centralized crypto-asset trading platform continuing the former Bitci exchange operation under the SAFEbit name, with TRY-funded trading, spot markets, deposits, withdrawals, staking, and mobile access.
entity.notes: SAFEbit is treated as the continuing Bitci exchange entity rather than a separate successor. The company states that its commercial title changed on 2025-06-12 while services, user balances, accounts, transactions, and obligations continued unchanged. The Turkish Capital Markets Board lists the current SAFEbit title and former Bitci title on its temporary operating list, but explicitly states that list inclusion is not authorization.

events.title: Bitci continued under the SAFEbit name
events.description: The Turkish exchange changed its commercial title from Bitci Kripto Varlık Alım Satım Platformu A.Ş. to SAFEbit Kripto Varlık Alım Satım Platformu A.Ş., while stating that services, user accounts, balances, transactions, and obligations continued unchanged.
events.notes: This is an in-place commercial-title and brand continuation, not a predecessor-successor split.

evidence.title: SAFEbit official exchange platform
evidence.notes: Current first-party platform exposes TRY-funded crypto buying and selling, spot trading, deposits, withdrawals, staking, mobile access, and account registration.

evidence.title: SAFEbit reminder announcement on the company-title change
evidence.notes: First-party announcement states that the title change became official on 2025-06-12 and did not affect services, accounts, balances, transactions, or obligations.

evidence.title: Temporary list of operating crypto-asset service providers
evidence.notes: The current temporary list identifies Safebit Kripto Varlık Alım Satım Platformu AŞ and the former Bitci Borsa Teknoloji AŞ title. The regulator warns that inclusion does not itself constitute authorization.
